name: When should I begin the custom tiny home design process?

mainEntity.name: When should I begin the custom tiny home design process?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is best to begin the custom tiny home design process well in advance of your desired move-in date. Starting early allows ample time for thorough planning, site preparation, obtaining permits, and construction. Ideally, you should initiate design discussions once you have secured your land or identified a specific location, as site characteristics significantly influence design decisions. Early engagement also helps in budgeting accurately and avoiding potential delays.
acceptedAnswer.description: Begin the custom tiny home design process well before your desired move-in date, ideally after securing your land, to allow for thorough planning, permitting, and construction.
